newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian BFC looks at controlling financial studies.
newsitem.headline: Belgian BFC looks at controlling financial studies.

text.p: Belgium's regulatory Banking and Finance Commission (BFC) is to look at potential conflicts of interest in the way a single broker can publish a prospectus and a financial study on a company, the BFC confirmed on Thursday.

"There will be a meeting (on Thursday) of the various parties involved for an exchange of views," BFC spokesman Edward Cloet told Reuters, confirming an article in Belgian newspaper L'Echo. Cloet said this meeting was a "first initiative".
L'Echo said the CBF was studying a possible solution whereby it would examine such financial analyses before they were published to check they were objective.

It would also check that the prospectus for a company's flotation or share issue contained all the pertinent information in a financial analysis of the stock by the same broker, such as justification for the price of a stock issue, outlooks and sector ratios, L'Echo added.
